desc: force the most important ec-fonts to be calculated
r: allec - force the most important ec-fonts to be calculated

allec forces a large number of ec-style Fonts to be calculated as pixel files. This is done through running dvips(1) over a certain test-file. Therefore, the fonts are created in the resolution needed by dvips.

If the -r flag is specified, the command dvired(1) will be used instead of dvips.

alldc does not recalculate existing fonts (as long as the Metafont mode does not change).
